# SK Attestation Services

Independent document preparation and process guidance. No official-agent appointment or authority to issue authentication is claimed.

## Services
- [Mosadaqa Guidance](https://ksa.salaroutsourcing.com/services/mosadaqa/): Understand the verification request, prepare questions for your university, and check the official platform instructions.
- [QVP Qualification Guidance](https://ksa.salaroutsourcing.com/services/qvp/): Clarify the qualification-verification request behind your Saudi employment process.
- [Saudi Culture Requirements Guidance](https://ksa.salaroutsourcing.com/services/saudi-culture/): Make sense of a cultural-office or academic verification request without assuming every case follows the same route.
- [Saudi Embassy Requirements Guidance](https://ksa.salaroutsourcing.com/services/saudi-embassy/): Understand the recipient’s request and the official consular instructions before arranging a submission.
- [UAE Embassy Requirements Guidance](https://ksa.salaroutsourcing.com/services/uae-embassy/): Prepare for a UAE document request using the current official service and mission instructions.
- [Document Issue Review](https://ksa.salaroutsourcing.com/services/document-review/): Identify name differences, missing records and unresolved queries before resubmitting.

## Scope
Official platforms, issuers and recipients make decisions. Applicant-only and restricted steps must follow the official rules.
